qa.recommendation: Leave Owner(s) as Caithness Long Island LLC [100%] for now. Look for the name of the entity that holds the plant after the sale, for example in a New York Public Service Commission filing or a state air permit transfer.
qa.note: The sale to Lotus Infrastructure Partners closed on January 7, 2026, according to a closing announcement republished in January 2026. Lotus plans to rename the plant the Brookhaven Energy Center. The announcements say Lotus bought the economic interests and do not name the company that now holds the plant. The EIA-860M table for August 2026 still lists the owner as Caithness Long Island, LLC. So the holding company may be unchanged under new parent ownership. I did not find a second independent publisher.
